Triage (R+146): lands in `packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column-provenance.ts` ⇒ `domain:spec`. Graded `Bug` · `priority:p2` · `i18n`.

`Bug`: nothing widens. Every eligible object is spread with hard-coded English display names, so a fully zh-CN app reads 名称 / 阶段 / 金额 / **Organization** / **Created By** / **Owner**.

`priority:p2` — user-visible on **every non-English tenant, on every business object, across list views, detail layouts, filter pickers and lookup chips**. ⛔ Not p1: nothing breaks, no data is wrong, and the app is fully usable.

⭐ **The downstream cost is measured, not argued.** On the 2026-09-03 zh-CN rig it was visible enough that the AI build agent **surfaced it to the end user every single round**, asking them to decide whether to translate fields **they never declared**. cloud#1904 fixed the consumer half by suppressing the report — correctly, since the user cannot act on it — which means the English labels now ship with the one thing that noticed them switched off. ⇒ ⛔ Do not read cloud#1904's landing as this being smaller than it was.

### ⛔ Why this is not a one-line `label` swap — carry this into the dispatch

`applySystemFields`' own comment forbids both obvious routes:

> the definitions must stay **byte-identical** to the shipped tables, because the #7859 Layer-0 guard and the #4326 round-trip strip both read them **by exact identity**. Do not add keys here; consumers ask the API.

⇒ ⛔ Localisation cannot be done by mutating the definitions in place, **and it cannot be done by adding a key to them either.** A dev who starts by editing `AUDIT_FIELD_DEFS` will take two guards red and will be right to stop.

### The question this card actually asks

*Where does a system column's **display** name come from, and who resolves it against the tenant locale?* Three shapes, and the card names them without choosing:

1. presentation-layer resolution at the **read exit** (`applyInjectedSystemColumns`), leaving the identity-stable definitions untouched;
2. an **i18n key alongside** the definition, resolved by consumers;
3. an explicit ruling that **these stay English**.

⛔ **Routed as work, not escalated**, per the filer's own reading that this is a `packages/spec` seat call. ⚠️ **If the chosen shape adds authorable or published surface** — option 2 most likely does — that is `Clause-②` and the contract-review tier, and if the seat concludes the answer is option 3 (a deliberate product statement that platform columns are English), that is a **product decision** and goes to the decision inbox. Say which at claim time rather than at PR time.

⭐ Option 1 is the only one that is obviously compatible with the byte-identity constraint, since it never touches the definitions. Worth establishing first whether the read exit has the tenant locale in hand — if it does not, that is the real size of this card.

⛔ `OWNING_BUSINESS_UNIT_FIELD_DEF` is `hidden: true` and therefore not user-visible today. Fix it with the rest for consistency, ⛔ but do not count it as part of the harm.

⚠️ The dedupe is stated and checked (#14319, #3370, #8094, #5083, #5419, #7634 — all closed, none covering the injected definitions). Re-verify before filing anything adjacent.

Declared **yes** so the dispatch runs at the contract tier; the in-seat review after delivery decides on the real diff (a declaration overturned by the tier review is the mechanism working, per the 2026-09-01 ruling). **Seat readings (`origin/main` `581d8f84c`, 2026-09-05T04:00Z)** — the premise is narrower than the card's title: `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts:2094` already carries a built-in label table for the injected columns (`owner_id`, `created_at`, `created_by`, `updated_at`, `updated_by` in `en` / `zh-CN` / `ja-JP` / `es-ES`), applied by `builtinSystemFieldLabel` (`:2108`, one call site `:2244`) only while a field still carries its injected English default — the path that renders `created_at` as `创建时间` in #14882's own reproduction. The tenant-scope column (`Organization`, `hidden: true` on its definition), the owner column as the definition names it, and `Owning Business Unit` are the rows to measure. Definitions in `packages/spec/src/data/injected-system-column-provenance.ts` are byte-identity guarded (`objectql/src/registry.ts:494-496`) and are NOT edited.

**File face**: `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.ts` (the `SYSTEM_FIELD_LABELS` / `builtinSystemFieldLabel` region only — disjoint from PR #15707's header and `ResolveOptions` docblock hunks, which land first; the dev merges `main` before opening the PR) · `packages/spec/src/system/i18n-resolver.test.ts` · one `@objectstack/spec` changeset. ⛔ Not touched: the definitions file above; the generated i18n bundles (held with PR #15626); `packages/metadata-protocol` / `packages/metadata-core` read exits (engine lane — PR #15395 / #14147 is in flight on `metadata-protocol/src/protocol.ts`; if the producer turns out to live there the dev STOPS and reports instead of editing). Targeted in-flight check on that basis: no intersection declared.

Dedup reading handed to the dev (MCP `search_issues` 2026-09-05T04:01Z, 4 results, #14972 the in-set control; #8195 · #7634 · #5083 closed and unrelated) — the card's own list (#14319 · #3370 · #8094 · #5083 · #5419 · #7634, all closed) stands.
